source.source_locator: 教則 第3章 3.1.2(3)3)a「使用の条件の遵守」（教則表示ページ24 / PDF viewer 29）

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: 機体認証を受けた無人航空機で特定飛行する場合は、指定された使用条件の範囲内で運航する。
evidence.tested_misconception: 機体認証を受けた機体なら、認証時に指定された高度・速度等の使用条件を超えても特定飛行できる。
evidence.reasoning_path: certified aircraft -> read specified use conditions -> keep operation inside certified envelope

collision.note: Tier A。Q049はカテゴリーII-Bの手続条件として機体認証を扱う。本問は認証機の運用限界そのものを問う。

independent_review.rationale: 3.1.2(3)3)a explicitly requires a certified UAS used for a specific flight to remain within specified operating conditions such as mass, altitude and speed. Q049 concerns the II-B procedural exemption route, not compliance with the certified operating envelope.

director_adjudication.rationale: The independent review correctly applies the quality-preserving 400-question contract to the B7 Chapter 3 Rules set. All 15 Tier A candidates test explicit source propositions not represented by the current 215-question accepted/source-verified canonical bank. The five Tier B candidates C001, C003, C008, C013 and C015 remain materially distinct through source-defined flight-phase, authority/exception, operation-subtype, response-sequence or moving-vehicle boundaries. None is retained as wording-only variation, none relies on a subsection marked 〔一等〕, and none is accepted merely to fill a numeric quota.
